## Concern formation and comparative benefit

6 October 2026. The concurrent [§12 contribution](#12-formed-appreciation-and-the-claim-of-added-good) now develops the formation comparison, its positive candidate and the disputed additional benefit. This continuation preserves that work and supplies an explicit comparison interface for the integral. It is not a second independent grounding result. The [source receipt](WHOLE-PROCESS-REALIZATION-SOURCES.md#concern-formation-and-fulfillment) likewise records a further reading of the same Dietz work, not another source of evidence.

Three complete continuations identify the baselines:

| Continuation | Intrinsic concern for the encounter | Relevant encounter |
|---|---|---|
| N | Does not form | Actually occurs |
| F | Forms | Fails to occur |
| R | Forms | Actually occurs |

N and R supply the formation comparison. F is a separate fulfillment contrast, so it does not share their fixed-accomplishment control. Formation can coincide with fulfillment in R; F is not an assumed earlier phase through which R must pass. Concern, its object, costs, permissions and later effects require identification in each history. These alternatives need not all be available to one actor at one decision point.

Suppose a defended account favors R over F. That does not yet favor R over N. Conversely, rejecting the second favorable comparison does not by itself erase the first. This is a restriction on the inference, not a counterexample to the composite candidate or a proof that every ordering can be realized. The [integral application](FUTURE-GOOD-INTEGRAL.md#concern-formation-changes-the-comparison) gives the value-difference identity under explicitly fixed conditions; a later actor's changed information cannot silently replace one term.

The affirmative relation in §§9 and 12 remains real and potentially good: concern and engagement can form together without an external evaluator donating a preexisting preference. Its superiority to informed indifference is a further claim. Matching pleasant intensity and duration also does not match all intentional experience. A rival can accept the new relation without accepting an extra welfare contribution; no new good is created solely by adding another applicable description.

This optional enrichment of G does not make a helper's acquired concern a gate on another's existing burden. The governing minimum still needs the independent warrant of actual adversity and its prospective significance for eligible response. The completed comparison audit leaves that ground unresolved; it supplies no new normative premise, empirical finding, Lean axiom or necessity proof.

**Internal review:** the counterreviewer accepted the reduced comparison and the repaired integral identity, including fixed distributions, finite expectations, actor feasibility and later reconditioning. The source reviewer accepted the reconciled reading scopes. The concurrent §12 contribution is preserved rather than counted as independent corroboration. [Integration checks](CONCERN-FORMATION-CHECKS.json) concern only owned additions, links and protected formal files; they do not validate the ethical identification.

## Concern formation changes the comparison

6 October 2026. The [concern-formation comparison](WHOLE-PROCESS-REALIZATION-ARGUMENT.md#concern-formation-and-comparative-benefit) distinguishes N, actual engagement without new intrinsic concern; F, formation of that concern with failed engagement; and R, formation with actual engagement. Evidence for favorable fulfillment compares R with F. Favorable formation compares R with N. Neither comparison can silently stand in for the other. A participant's welfare advantage also does not automatically establish a favorable whole appraisal; the latter must assess the other affected realizations and relationships.

For X in {N,F,R}, fix a causally supported distribution μ_X of histories under one declared comparison context. Use the same whole appraisal G_T and horizon throughout, and suppose all three expectations are finite. Define

\[
V_T(X)=\mathbb E_{\mu_X}[G_T(H)].
\]

Subtraction then gives

\[
V_T(R)-V_T(N)
=\bigl[V_T(R)-V_T(F)\bigr]+\bigl[V_T(F)-V_T(N)\bigr].
\]

A positive first difference on the right does not establish a positive left side. This elementary value identity supplies no welfare scale or sign. Where the compared arrangements are feasible for the specified actor under §1's conditions, their difference represents Δ_T for that comparison. Joint feasibility is not presumed by the identity. A later responder's newly conditioned distribution is not automatically the same μ_X; the comparison must be rebuilt or the correspondence justified. Undefined infinite expectations cannot be cancelled, and an ordinal or incomplete appraisal need not admit these differences.

Different feasible baselines can therefore give different action significance without assigning different ethical quality to the very same complete history merely because a different evaluator considers it. This explanatory option does not establish that every welfare theory accepts the same appraisal. Nor does it justify forming a concern because satisfying it would later help. The proposed present good must be defended within the whole; changed organization cannot be counted as an additional benefit solely because another description now applies.

**Concern formation and its value, 6 October 2026:** [the comparison](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PROCESS-REALIZATION-ARGUMENT.md#concern-formation-and-comparative-benefit) distinguishes a genuinely changed way of living an encounter from an established welfare increment. Its primary comparator and [integral application](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/FUTURE-GOOD-INTEGRAL.md#concern-formation-changes-the-comparison) separate benefit after concern forms from benefit through forming it. The affirmative increment remains disputed; this optional enrichment does not become a prerequisite for existing burdens to matter. The minimum's independent adversity-to-response ground remains unresolved.

**Formation is a separate value comparison, 6 October 2026:** [the concern test](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PROCESS-REALIZATION-ARGUMENT.md#concern-formation-and-comparative-benefit) identifies a real new relation when participation becomes intrinsically cared about, while leaving its additional benefit contested. The [integral application](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/FUTURE-GOOD-INTEGRAL.md#concern-formation-changes-the-comparison) keeps formation and subsequent fulfillment comparisons distinct. Neither good's return to an initiator nor a helper's newly acquired concern is a gate on the existing ethical minimum candidate; its universal grounding remains unfinished.
